questions.text: Outline any concerns regarding the impact of the Acquisition on competition, including if any businesses controlled by Thoma Bravo (such as Dayforce), are close competitors with Tanda and there are not many alternatives, or if Tanda is a major supplier to a business controlled by Thoma Bravo, or vice-versa.
Provide any additional information or comments that you consider relevant to the ACCC’s assessment of the Acquisition.
Provide a brief description of your business or organisation, including any commercial relationships with Thoma Bravo, Dayforce, and/or Tanda.
